COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Cloud Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cloud Computing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cloud Computing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cloud Computing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cloud Computing.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

5. When learning Artificial Intelligence Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Concepts.

6. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.

9. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

10. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cybersecurity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.

11. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.

12. When learning Data Analysis and Visualisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Analysis and Visualisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Analysis and Visualisation.

13. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Structures.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Structures.

14. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

16. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development II and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Software Development Life Cycle and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Software Project Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Technologies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
